reply_text:
I saved Hollis's note that their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is Gate 40 from now on, and told them in their DM.

The first save came out visible to everyone. Since Hollis told me this in a DM, I saved it again so only they can see it and withdrew the first copy. Only that private copy is still in use.

Nothing else was needed: they said no action was required, and I didn't share the note anywhere.
